merchant/31306.htm.text: Trader Natasha: Wow! You're an adventurer? Really? I envy you! You earn honor and wealth... and everyone loves you! Sigh...! I hate my life! Everyday I sit in this store, saying the same things over and over again... "Welcome!" and "Have a nice day!"... Everyday, it's the same thing! I'm so bored!

links.text: See the lord and get the tax rate information

merchant/31306-pk.htm.text: Trader Natasha: Aaaaah~! Murderer~! Monster~!!! Help me~! Get out! Get out! Get the hell out of here!!!

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
